title: Classify protected acceptance-mailbox input shape without disclosure or production access
acceptance: the classifier is owner-only and bound to release issue 3072 and registration matrix 3785
the classifier applies the same protected mailbox user, password and recipient-template shape checks used by the Web-container SMTP delivery proof
only one whitelisted categorical reason code is published
secret values, lengths, hashes, mailbox identity, recipient template and credentials are never published
SMTP, IMAP, SSH, Web-container, database, runtime and deployment access are not performed
reviewer identity, reviewer reset, password, TOTP and session material are not accessed
the exact current main guard is checked before and after classification
a final main drift suppresses publication and cannot emit stale PASS evidence
